versions.changelog:
Initial release of Houseplant Watering Computer.

- Calculates precise watering amounts and schedules per pot based on substrate, pot size, plant type, light, temperature, and humidity
- Diagnoses over- and under-watering symptoms and interprets moisture checks
- Supports self-watering pot setup and care, including cache pots
- Generates per-pot care cards with recommended moisture-check dates
- Includes detailed substrate water-holding guidance and common pitfalls to avoid
- Works offline with standard Python 3; no external dependencies
